name: Valid Hybrid Dual-Signature (Classical ECDSA P-384 + Post-Quantum ML-DSA-65)
proven_requirements: Hybrid dual-signature verification succeeds when both classical and post-quantum components are authentic
condition: Both classical ECDSA P-384 and post-quantum ML-DSA-65 signatures are valid on VC and VP

name: Negative: Missing Classical Signature Component
proven_requirements: Hybrid verifier rejects credentials missing the mandatory classical component
condition: Strip ECDSA P-384 signature, leaving only ML-DSA-65 component

name: Negative: Missing Post-Quantum Signature Component (Downgrade Attempt)
proven_requirements: Hybrid verifier rejects classical-only credentials and prevents algorithm downgrade
condition: Strip ML-DSA-65 signature, presenting classical-only artifact to hybrid verifier

name: Negative: Invalid Classical Signature Component
proven_requirements: Hybrid verifier rejects credentials with corrupt classical signature component
condition: Mutate ECDSA P-384 signature bytes while keeping valid ML-DSA-65 signature

name: Negative: Invalid Post-Quantum Signature Component
proven_requirements: Hybrid verifier rejects credentials with corrupt ML-DSA-65 signature component
condition: Mutate ML-DSA-65 signature bytes while keeping valid ECDSA P-384 signature

name: Negative: Algorithm Downgrade to Prohibited Classical-Only Profile
proven_requirements: Hybrid verifier rejects headers specifying classical algorithms in hybrid profile
condition: Modify JOSE header alg parameter to non-hybrid algorithm

name: Negative: Wrong Role Cryptographic Key or Disabled Profile
proven_requirements: Verifier rejects signatures generated with keys not authorized for the issuer role
condition: Sign VC using Verifier or Wallet key instead of Bank Issuer key
